tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lan gtor gtong tshul dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun blos brtsams pa bzhugs so// lan gtor grangs gsog byed tshe shom rgyun gyi phyag len bzhin las/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ mchog sbyin bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te sogs gang mang / mthar de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ ting shag dkrol la/ na mo dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /gsang sngags rigs sngags mthu stobs dang / /bdag dang yon gyi bdag po yi/ /lhag bsam rmad byung bden pa'i mthus/ /rat+na las grub snod yangs par/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /'dod yon lnga yi rang bzhin la/ /stong gsum khyab par blos sprul te/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs nas/ /'bul ba'i yul du gyur pa ni/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /bskal mang 'das pa'i sngon rol nas/ /sha 'khon lan chags mgron gnyer ba'i/ /mi dang mi min gdug pa can/ /bsad pas tshe la gnod pa dang / brgyab pas nad mang skyed byed cing / /brkus 'phrogs la sogs las ngan gyis/ /longs spyod dbul bar byed pa'i gdon/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs/ /mi dang mi min thams cad la/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /skye ba 'dir yang nongs pa'i tshogs/ /ci mchis byang zhing dag gyur nas/ /gnod byed kun mnyes mchod rdzas 'di/ /spyan gyi yul du mdzes par 'bul/ /snyan gyi yul du snyan par 'bul/ /shangs kyi yul du zhim par 'bul/ /ljags kyi yul du bro bar 'bul/ /lus kyi yul du 'jam par 'bul/ /yid kyi yul du tshim par 'bul/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /bdag sogs sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe sngon lan chags sbyangs du gsol/

/'dir yang bdag cag gti mug pas/ /khyed rnams thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /phyin chad lan chags mgron khyer nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol/ mnan pa theg la bsdams pa lhod/ gnod pa'i sems kun bral gyur nas/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bde zhing skyid/ /dpal 'byor rigs brgyud 'khor rnams dar/ /lo legs phyugs 'phel snyan grags rgyas/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /gnod bya gnod byed thams cad kyang / /byang chub sems nyid cher 'phel te/ /dge bcu'i dpal la spyod gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub 'grub par shog /oṃ hi ta su ṣa bha wan+tu swā hā/ /zhes brjod/ yang nad pa lta bu'am gzhan yang dmigs bsal dgos tshe bsgrub bya gang yin pa de'i gzugs glud la lo grangs kyi khram shing btsugs pa dang / mar me/ mtheb skyu/ ril bu/ chang bu/ bsgrub bya'i dri zan rnams lhan cig tu bzhag pa gong gi cho gas bsngos nas 'dre lnga bdud gcod sogs gnod byed gar gnas kyi sar bskyal lo/ /zhes pa 'di yang gnyer thog las 'dzin bsod nams mchog ldan gyis bskul ba'i ngor sa skya kun blos sbyar ba dge/ // zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ lan gtor gtong tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
